purpose: diagnose what 'idling' means in the M7d btt_reward_v2 policies

definitions.notation: L(e) episode length in native ticks; T(e) targets broken; B(e) = (b_1 < ... < b_T) target-break ticks; end(e) end reason; H = 3600 horizon
definitions.tail: tail(e) = L - (b_T + 1) if T >= 1 else L
definitions.survival_matched: for window W, the mean of T_W over the survivor set S_W = {e : L(e) >= W}; the survivor rate |S_W|/n is reported beside it, never folded into it
definitions.phase_progress: targets broken in [lo, hi) over episodes with L(e) >= hi
definitions.action_entropy: H = -sum p log2 p in bits over the empirical action distribution; max log2(72) = 6.1699 joint, log2(9) = 3.1699 stick, log2(8) = 3 button
definitions.long_run_share: fraction of ticks inside a maximal run of >= 60 identical actions
definitions.full_neutral_share: fraction of ticks with stick index 0 and button index 0 (no input at all)
definitions.head_tail_contrast: head = ticks [0, b_T], tail = ticks (b_T, L); deltas are tail minus head
definitions.final_state_cluster: binning of the FINAL position only; trajectory occupancy is not stored
definitions.learning_curve_class: Theil-Sen slope s (targets per 1e6 transitions) against a noise scale eps; improving if s > eps and last-third minus first-third > 0; regressing if the mirror image; plateaued if |s| <= eps; too_noisy if slope and delta disagree
definitions.entropy_fraction: H / H_max where H is SB3's mean per-state policy entropy in nats and H_max = ln 9 + ln 8 = 4.2767 (uniform over Track 1)
definitions.deceleration: (entropy slope over the last third) / (entropy slope over the whole run); ~1 means the policy is still concentrating at full speed at the budget's end
definitions.collapse_share: max_run / L for a deterministic play; >= 0.5 is a collapsed argmax policy
